note: Private family campground (est. 1968) on 160 acres in the West River valley, Townshend; 62 pull-throughs, a separate tent area and group camping. Many sites are seasonal: on the operator's 2025 site map the row along the West River is nearly all seasonal (the nightly sites in that row are 212-216, 219, 220, 222 and 223), and the river is reached through marked access points only. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read in a browser (plain HTTP 406): $25 water-only / $40 water+electric (undated page, footer 2010-2025), AC $8, guests 18+ $5, 6% tax; phone/email booking, full payment, no refunds; open May through Columbus Day; 190 sites, pull-throughs, water at all sites; showers/dump/laundry/store. Google 4.6 (60). Waterfront lead: riverfront -> riverview recommended (bank tree strip, marked river accesses only, river row mostly seasonal).
